result.instructions: Tools for DynaPictures, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my DynaPictures templates and the layer names in the social banner one."; "Generate a certificate image for Ana Novak from the certificate template."; "Build an image link for the event banner with the speaker name and photo.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes DynaPictures data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run dynapictures_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run dynapictures_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run dynapictures_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. dynapictures_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: dynapictures_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List the DynaPictures workspaces the API key's user belongs to, with their id and role. Good first call: the workspace id is needed for templates and media. GET /workspaces.

tools.name: dynapictures_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the templates that have 'Sync to Zapier' enabled, with their uid, name and layer names. Layer names are what generate_image overrides. Optionally filter by workspace id. GET /templates.

workspace_id.description: Only templates in this workspace id (from dynapictures_list_workspaces).

tools.name: dynapictures_get_template
tools.title: Get a template
tools.description: Get one template by uid, with its layers (name, type, size, text). Use the layer names when you call generate_image or build_image_link. GET /templates/{uid}.

tools.name: dynapictures_search_generated_images
tools.title: Search generated images
tools.description: Find images the caller's teams generated, oldest first, up to 200 per call. Filter by keyword, metadata text, or a start and end date. Use the date filters for large result sets. GET /generated-images.

metadata.description: Metadata text stored with the image.

start_date.description: Start of the date range, as the DynaPictures API expects (for example 2026-11-01).

end_date.description: End of the date range, as the DynaPictures API expects (for example 2026-11-30).

tools.name: dynapictures_list_media_assets
tools.title: List media assets
tools.description: List the images and folders in a workspace's media library, 30 per page. Use the asset url in other tools or in generate_image layers. GET /media/{workspaceId}/assets.

tools.name: dynapictures_get_media_asset
tools.title: Get a media asset
tools.description: Get one media asset by id, with its url, thumbnail url, mime type and size. GET /media/{workspaceId}/assets/{assetId}.

tools.name: dynapictures_build_image_link
tools.title: Build an image link
tools.description: Build a public image URL for a template with layer overrides, with no API call and no credit used. Paste it into an tag or a page; the image renders when the link is opened. Identical links return a cached image.

property.description: Property to set, for example text, imageUrl or color.

metadata.description: Custom text stored on the generated image.

tools.name: dynapictures_generate_image
tools.title: Generate an image
tools.description: Render a template with your data and return the image URL. Each image or PDF page uses one image credit. Requests are NOT idempotent: a repeated call uses another credit, so do not retry a call that may have succeeded. POST /designs/{uid}.

format.description: Output format (default png). pdf and pptx use one image credit per page.

text.description: New text for a text layer.

imageUrl.description: Public image URL for an image layer.

metadata.description: Custom text stored on the generated image.

tools.name: dynapictures_upload_media_from_url
tools.title: Upload media from a URL
tools.description: Add an image to a workspace's media library from a public URL. The new asset can then be used in template layers. POST /media/{workspaceId}/assets/from-url.

url.description: Public image URL to copy into the library.

name.description: File name to store the asset under.

folder_uid.description: Folder id to place the asset in.
